description: Search freehire's catalogue of IT job postings. Use for any question about which jobs are open — by technology, seniority, location, pay or employer. Returns a short preview of each posting.

category.description: role family, e.g. backend, frontend, devops, data

company_slugs.description: employer identifiers, as carried by a result's company_slug

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, e.g. DE, BR

employment_type.description: any of full_time, part_time, contract, internship

exclude_company_slugs.description: employers to leave out, as carried by a result's company_slug

exclude_skills.description: technologies the posting must not ask for, e.g. php

query.description: free text, matched against title, company, description and location. Operators: double quotes require every quoted word in any order (not a phrase); -word excludes; uppercase OR between terms matches any alternative (at most 5), e.g. golang OR rust; title: at the start of an alternative matches it in the title only, e.g. title:"product owner" OR title:produktchef

regions.description: any of global, north_america, latam, eu, uk, mena, africa, apac, cis

relocation.description: any of supported (the employer helps you move), required (the role needs you to move), not_supported

require_all_skills.description: true: every listed skill must be present, not just one

semantic.description: true: also match postings that describe the query in other words, e.g. 'help kids learn to read' finding a reading interventionist. Needs query. Covers technical roles; elsewhere the keyword hits answer

seniority.description: any of intern, junior, middle, senior, lead, staff, principal, c_level

name: search_jobs

ignored_params.description: filters that were not applied; the answer is wider than asked

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes the role is open in

first_seen_at.description: RFC3339 UTC; when freehire first saw this posting — a posted_at far newer than this means the date was refreshed

official_job_url.description: the employer's own posting, when known

source.description: the job board this posting was collected from

summary.description: a short preview, not the full description

semantic.description: applied: matched by meaning as asked; unavailable: answered by keywords only

title: Search jobs
